evidence.V3: Confident stylised proportions: chunky bulge, strongly chamfered top chime and rounded base, hoops sized to read at distance; not a stiff cylinder.
evidence.V4: Hoops show a consistent chamfer that catches a bright highlight on the top edge, rim chime is bevelled, nails are faceted hex heads; bevel scale consistent across parts.
